t: Loudoun delays vote on one-year data center application pause to Nov. 17
b: The board moved its planned Oct. 20 vote on pausing legislative data center and substation applications for a year. Officials said they need more time to gather information. The draft exempts grid-reliability substations.
iw: Pause still looms over 33 pending applications in top market.

t: Grant County, New Mexico approves one-year data center moratorium
b: Commissioners voted 4-1 to bar building, expanding or operating data centers, and dedicated power, water and transmission infrastructure, in unincorporated areas from Nov. 21, 2026 to Nov. 21, 2027, while the county studies regulation.
iw: Outright one-year ban on new projects and supporting infrastructure.

t: Memphis council rejects long data center moratorium, passes 135-day construction pause instead
b: A proposed 18-month moratorium failed on a tie. Members then approved a substitute ordinance halting data center construction for 135 days, meant to complement the mayor's 90-day impact study order. Some members said they had little time to review it.
iw: Shorter pause than proposed, but still halts construction for months.
